title: Derkach
summary: Derkach is a Ukrainian surname that translates to 'ratchet' or 'noisemaker.' It is associated with several notable individuals, primarily from [[ukraine|Ukraine]], across various fields such as politics, sports, and music.

sections.heading: Meaning and Origin
paragraphs: The surname Derkach, written in Cyrillic as Деркач, has its roots in the [[ukrainian|Ukrainian language]], where it means a ratchet or noisemaker.

sections.heading: Notable Individuals
paragraphs: Andrii Derkach (born 1967) is a prominent Ukrainian politician and businessman.
Andriy Derkach (born 1985) is recognized as a Ukrainian football player.
Borys Derkach (1964−2019) was a Soviet and Ukrainian footballer known for his contributions to the sport.
Dariya Derkach (born 1993) competes as an Italian triple jumper and long jumper.
Len Derkach (born 1945) is a Canadian politician with Ukrainian heritage.
Leonid Derkach (1939−2022) was a Ukrainian politician and the father of Andrii Derkach.
Sergei Derkach (born 1966) is a Russian football player and coach.
Volodymyr Derkach (born 1957) is a Ukrainian musician with a significant impact on the cultural scene.
Vyacheslav Derkach (born 1976) is a Ukrainian biathlete who has represented the country in international competitions.
Yana Derkach (born 1998) is another Ukrainian football player contributing to the sport.

sections.heading: Cultural Impact
paragraphs: The Derkach surname is associated with various fields, showcasing the contributions of individuals to Ukrainian culture, sports, and politics.
